MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE

SCHEDULE A

CONDITION

Maintenance operation —
A = Check and adjust if necessary.
B = Clean
C = Inspect and correct or replace if necessary.

• Revise or transfer a trailer, using a camper or car-top carrier.
• Repeated short trips of less than 8 miles (13 km) when outside temperature remains below freezing.
• Extensive idling and/or low speed operation such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use.
• Operating on dusty, rough, muddy, or salt spread roads.
